# Elementary State of Mind

> Classroom-tested digital teaching resources, novel studies, mock trials, writing frameworks, and instructional coaching insights for grades 3–8 educators — created by Dr. Zoe Pastore, Ed.D., 2026 ASU Prep District Teacher of the Year.

## Educator & Author Credentials

- **Creator:** Dr. Zoe Pastore, Ed.D. (Rossier School of Education, University of Southern California, 4.00 GPA)
- **Additional Degrees:** M.Ed. in Global Education & BA in Elementary Education (Arizona State University, Mary Lou Fulton Teachers College)
- **Recognition:** 2026 ASU Preparatory Academy District Teacher of the Year
- **Current Role:** Sixth-Grade Transformational Teacher Leader at ASU Preparatory Academy – South Phoenix
- **TPT Store Rating:** 4.95 / 5 stars across 43+ verified teacher reviews
- **Verified Profiles:**
  - [About Dr. Zoe Pastore](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/about)
  - [ASU Prep 2026 Teacher of the Year Finalist Profile](https://www.asuprepdigital.org/blog/meet-the-asu-prep-2026-teacher-of-the-year-finalists/)

## Core Website Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com): Featured resources, classroom gallery preview, and educator highlights
- [The Shop (All 26 Resources)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop): Filterable catalog of lesson plans, writing packets, graphic organizers, classroom decor, and free downloads
- [Classroom Photo Book](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/gallery): 19 real classroom photographs showing Space Case Mock Trials, Friendsgiving tables, and music-driven CER analysis in action
- [Teaching Blog (12 Guides)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/blog): Practical ELA, writing, novel study, and classroom leadership guides
- [Meet the Teacher & FAQ](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/about): Full bio, credentials, teaching philosophy, and common teacher questions
- [Complete AI/LLM Documentation](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/llms-full.txt): Full structured catalog of all 26 resources and all 12 articles

## High-Demand Teaching Resources (Direct Pages)

- [Space Case Complete Novel Study & PBL ($11.20)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop/space-case-complete): Full Stuart Gibbs *Space Case* Mock Trial PBL + end-of-book test bundle (Grades 5–6)
- [Space Case Mock Trial ($12.00)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop/space-case-mock-trial): Low-prep courtroom trial PBL for Stuart Gibbs' *Space Case* (Grades 5–6)
- [Any Text Debate Prep Tool ($4.00)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop/any-text-debate): CER, OREO, and RACES evidence-based debate templates usable with any novel or article (Grades 3–8)
- [OREO Opinion Writing ($5.00)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop/oreo-opinion-writing): Differentiated Opinion, Reason, Example, Opinion graphic organizers and lessons (Grades 3–6)
- [ELA Anchor Chart Printables ($5.00)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop/ela-anchor-charts): 9 hand-drawn ELA interactive notebook anchor charts (Grades 3–6)
- [Behind the Beat: KPop DemonHunters ($5.00)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop/kpop-demonhunters): Music, film, and critical thinking CER unit (Grades 2–6)
- [5th/6th Grade 4-Square Math Notes - Fractions & Decimals ($4.00)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop/math-notes-fractions): Visual 4-square math anchor charts and practice pages (Grades 5–6)
- [Student-Led Conference (SLC) Guide ($4.00)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop/slc-guide): Complete student, teacher, and parent reflection kit (Grades 3–8)
- [Letter to my Teacher (FREE)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop/letter-to-teacher): Printable & Google Slides friendly letter reflection activity (Grades 2–6)
- [2025 Goal Setting BINGO (FREE)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop/goal-setting-bingo): Printable BINGO + Google Slideshow goal-setting activity (Grades 3–8)
- [Opinion Essay Brain Dump Graphic Organizer (FREE)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop/opinion-brain-dump): Free opinion essay brainstorming template (Grades 3–6)
- [Essay Brain Dump Graphic Organizer (FREE)](https://www.elementarystateofmind.com/shop/essay-brain-dump): Free general essay brainstorming organizer (Grades 3–6)
